headers_missing.description: No HSTS header. Browsers may connect over plain HTTP, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
headers_missing.remediation: Add the header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

leaky_headers.remediation: Remove or genericize the Server header to avoid version disclosure.

headers_missing.description: No CSP header. The site is more vulnerable to XSS attacks from inline scripts and untrusted sources.
headers_missing.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header. Start restrictive: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'

headers_missing.description: No X-Frame-Options header. The site may be vulnerable to clickjacking.
headers_missing.remediation: Add the header: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN)

headers_missing.description: No X-Content-Type-Options header. Browsers may MIME-sniff responses, potentially executing malicious content.
No Referrer-Policy header. Full URLs (including query params) may leak to third-party sites via the Referer header.
No Permissions-Policy header. Browser features like camera, microphone, and geolocation are not explicitly restricted.
headers_missing.remediation: Add the header: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
